title: Database connection timeouts in production
summary: Intermittent connection timeouts to primary PostgreSQL database. Connection pool exhaustion suspected. Increased pool size from 20 to 50, monitoring metrics.

title: API latency spike on /users endpoint
summary: P95 latency increased to 2s on /users endpoint. Root cause: missing index on users.email column. Added index, latency returned to normal.

title: Login failures for OAuth users
summary: OAuth callback URL was returning 404 after recent deployment. Reverted nginx config change, logins restored.
